answer: An applicant rents bored basalt plug BP-7714 for 14 days and locks 15,400 tokens. A 40-mm stand opens only after the roof anemometer holds a gale of 14-19 m/s for six minutes; a logger must then match a 20-sample decay curve within 3 kPa of the factory record. A 180 g marble coupon, etched with the same serial, must assay at specific gravity 2.68 +/- 0.02 under two clerks on different shifts. A reused serial, a curve matching any 80-day filing, or a coupon off by 0.4 g burns 9,200 tokens and bars the name for 10 epochs. Each plug graduates one applicant every 18 days.
